content.title:
Integrative Care
that starts with your real life
content.subtitle: Fine Diet care pathways help translate symptoms, routines, and goals into practical next steps — without turning module copy into clinical truth.

content.heading: A pathway for turning signals into support.
content.intro: Use this section to explain the care journey at a high level while keeping product, pricing, booking, and clinical details in their source-of-truth layers.

steps.title: Start with context
steps.body: Capture the current season, routines, goals, and patterns that should shape the support path.

steps.title: Choose the right option
steps.body: Route visitors toward the current care product or pathway that fits what they are trying to solve.

steps.title: Move into the app or care flow
steps.body: Delivery, intake, scheduling, and ongoing work stay outside the module copy and inside the correct product systems.

steps.title: Adjust from what changes
steps.body: Use check-ins and feedback to decide whether the current pathway is enough or a different level of support is needed.

content.heading: Care works better when the system stays connected.
content.intro: Use this card rail for the parts of the Fine Diet system that support care without making the module the source of clinical, billing, or access truth.

cards.headline: Begin with the full picture.
cards.description: Help visitors understand that care begins with context: routines, goals, history, and current patterns.

cards.headline: Keep observations connected.
cards.description: Show how logs and notes can support a clearer conversation about what is changing over time.

cards.headline: Route to the right next step.
cards.description: Explain how care options can guide the visitor without hard-coding offer, checkout, or entitlement details.

content.heading: Support that respects the whole pattern.
content.body: Keep this copy conservative until final care claims are approved. The page should explain the pathway, not diagnose the visitor.

items.sentence: Start with symptoms, routines, meals, stress, sleep, and goals in context.
Make the next step easier to choose instead of overwhelming the visitor with every option.
Keep delivery, access, and product truth in the current source-of-truth layer.

items.question: How do I know which care option fits?
items.answer: Use the available care cards below to compare the current pathway options. Final booking, access, and delivery details should stay in the product flow.

items.question: Is this page medical advice?
items.answer: No. This page explains Fine Diet care pathways at a high level. Clinical, diagnostic, or practitioner-specific claims should be reviewed before publishing.

items.question: Where does the work happen?
items.answer: Public pages explain the pathway and route visitors. Intake, delivery, check-ins, and account-specific work should happen in the appropriate signed-in or product system.

content.heading: Choose the support path that fits this season.
content.intro: Keep this CTA flexible. The product cards below remain resolver-driven from Integrative Care product records.
items: Choose the path that matches the level of support needed.
Let the product flow handle booking, checkout, and access.
